description: Book the signed-in person a free 30-minute intro call with Ben, at a time from my_bookings (introCall.openTimes; pass its start exactly as listed, and name the time by its label, never by a weekday you work out). Book it here: do not send the person to a booking page unless this refuses or fails. No diamond, nothing charged; the calendar invite comes from cal.com. The answer's booking has its own label and join link; move it with move_booking, cancel it with cancel_booking. One upcoming free call per person at a time: while one stands, this refuses and names it. Offer the free 30-minute intro call with Ben when the person is interested in the Pirate Forge (the Forge Pass) or in working with Ben one to one – Captain on Deck, which people also call an in-house workshop, consulting or freelance work. Never offer it for the Pirate Pass or for an event ticket.

start.description: The start of a free intro-call time exactly as my_bookings lists it under introCall.openTimes, e.g. "2026-09-17T10:00:00.000+02:00".

timeZone.description: The person's time zone, e.g. "Europe/Berlin". Defaults to Berlin.

topic.description: What the person is deciding about (the Forge Pass, a Captain on Deck session) or wants to ask, in a sentence or two.

name: book_intro_call
